messages:
marta: Hey tagging release crew — quick check before we unpin runtime v3.2.1 from canary slice B. Heatmap shows latency bump but 99p still within SLO. Any strong objections? :eyes:
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary wave 5/8 started on slice B (router -> runtime -> api). wave id w-20260322-5
deploy-bot: Instances: router-b-2, runtime-b-6, api-b-3
alex: Where's the traffic quota for this slice? I see 12% max in console but router is still routing 8%. Is that expected?
marta: Console shows target 15% for wave 5, but runtime autoscale lagged; router kept it at 8 to avoid overshoot.
raj: If we unpin v3.2.1 now, what's fallback? Do we have a pinned fallback variant (v3.1.9-q4)?
jen: Yes fallback is v3.1.9-q4 on standby. Rollback policy: immediate if 5% error-rate increase over 10m or latency > 2s p99 for 5m.
alex: Can we get a quick heatmap snapshot? Want to see per-route regression.
marta: Pasting heatmap snippet:
```text
wave: w-20260322-5
routes:
  /generate: p50=120ms p95=340ms p99=780ms errors=0.7%
  /chat: p50=90ms p95=210ms p99=420ms errors=0.2%
  routing: sliceB=8% target=15% autoscale=lagging
```
raj: Looks OK for now. Suggest we unpin after wave reaches 40% of its planned traffic and no error spike.
jen: Also update release notes console: note that v3.2.1 includes kernel batching change that can affect tail latency on long-seq routes.
marta: Agree. I'll update release notes and add the rollback triggers to the release checklist. Then propose unpin at 1768920300 (10m from now) unless anyone asks hold.
alex: I'm +1. Will watch console metrics and the router traces.
deploy-bot: wave w-20260322-5 progress: 40% traffic target reached on slice B
marta: OK unpin command coming:
```bash
# unpin runtime v3.2.1 from slice B
deployctl unpin --slice B --service runtime --version v3.2.1 --reason "canary steady"
```
raj: Confirmed. I'll keep an eye on p99 and evictions (router).
jen: Adding note in release doc: "If p99 > 1.8s for 3 consecutive 1m buckets, revert and pin v3.1.9-q4, notify eng-releases and infra-oncall."
alex: Got it. :thumbsup: 
marta: Unpinned. monitor for 15m then full rollout if stable.
deploy-bot: action: unpin request accepted, queue id q-7722, executing
deploy-bot: action: unpin completed for runtime on slice B, timestamp 1768920312
alex: Seeing small bump at p99 ~800-900ms on /generate, still within policy.
raj: No evictions, router errors steady.
jen: I'll keep release notes updated and signal GO for the rest of waves if everything stays green.
marta: Thanks team — tagging @eng-oncall to be aware.
alex: pinged them.
